My intermediate results, for the expressions found in the problem statement, are:

\framebox{p\;=\;7\cdot 2025!-\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{5}\Big\lceil\frac{2025!}{p_i}\Big\rceil\;}\bigskip

\framebox{q\;=\;2025!}\bigskip

\framebox{p_i\;(i=0,\dots,5)\;=\;\{5,\;11549,\;11,\;5081287,\;29,\;17\}}\bigskip

\framebox{G\;=\;\gcd\!\bigl(2025!,\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{5}\big\lceil\frac{2025!}{p_i}\big\rceil\bigr)\;=\;2}\bigskip

\framebox{p+q\;=\;\dfrac{7\cdot2025!-\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{5}\big\lceil\frac{2025!}{p_i}\big\rceil}{G}\;}\bigskip

\framebox{p+q\pmod{99991}\;=\;1554}

Hence the required remainder is  

\[
{answer = 1554}
\]
